heading: I currently work at Sysco, testing and improving the Brakes website.

roles.title: Digital Optimisation Executive
roles.summary: Part of the Brand and Digital Optimisation team. I run A/B and multivariate tests in Salesforce Personalisation, build pages and reusable components in Amplience, manage categories and products in SAP, and report on performance to shape content, UX and trading decisions.

roles.title: Lead Senior Designer
roles.summary: Joined a new design agency at launch and looked after its brand guidelines and design system. Led WordPress builds from design to launch, with over 35 sites designed, including busy e-commerce stores, plus email campaigns and print work such as brochures and business cards.

roles.title: Senior Web Designer
roles.summary: Worked with the sales team and clients to take responsive websites from first brief to handover. Ran planning meetings, presented designs, briefed freelancers and set up domains and hosting.

roles.title: Web Manager
roles.summary: Led the move of TRI UK's website and IT systems into the Sports Direct group, modernising the e-commerce site and its payment gateway. Managed product data for thousands of products, designed online and print media, set up IT for three stores and worked with over twenty cycling brands on their London Bike Show stands.

roles.title: Digital Content Developer, contract
roles.summary: Made weekly Mailchimp newsletters for three stores and graphics for the website, social media and in-store use. Also ran the 2016 TRI UK catalogue, keeping suppliers and deadlines on track.
